nodes.name: orchestrate-viral-research.js
nodes.summary: End-to-end research orchestrator that scrapes niches via Apify, transcribes videos, computes DPS, extracts patterns, and writes per-niche research reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements its own cohort statistics + z-score-to-percentile math inline for DPS scoring.

nodes.name: triggerApifyScrape
nodes.summary: Kicks off an Apify actor run to scrape niche videos based on niche configuration.

nodes.name: transcribeNicheVideos
nodes.summary: Iterates over scraped videos for a niche and produces transcripts for downstream analysis.

nodes.name: calculateDPSForNiche
nodes.summary: Computes Dynamic Percentile System scores for every video in a niche using cohort-aware statistics.

nodes.name: calculateCohortStats
nodes.summary: Calculates mean and standard deviation for a cohort metric series.

nodes.name: calculateDPSForVideo
nodes.summary: Scores a single video by combining cohort z-scores across views, likes, comments, and shares.

nodes.name: calculateIdentityContainerScore
nodes.summary: Heuristically scores caption text for identity-container patterns used in pattern extraction.

nodes.name: extractPatternsForNiche
nodes.summary: Aggregates viral patterns across the niche's top scoring videos.

nodes.name: extractKnowledgeForNiche
nodes.summary: Distills high-level knowledge entries from the niche's pattern set.

nodes.name: generateResearchReport
nodes.summary: Produces a markdown research report summarising the niche's scoring, patterns, and knowledge.

nodes.name: runResearchPipeline
nodes.summary: Runs the full per-niche research pipeline from scrape through report.

nodes.name: runAllNiches
nodes.summary: Iterates over every configured niche and invokes the research pipeline serially.

nodes.name: parse-playwright.js
nodes.summary: Tiny utility that parses Playwright test output for downstream reporting.

nodes.name: populate-ffmpeg-data.ts
nodes.summary: Downloads videos and runs the ffmpeg service to populate visual feature columns (saturation, frames) for training rows.

nodes.name: downloadVideo
nodes.summary: Streams a remote video URL to disk, handling redirects and write errors.

nodes.name: processVideo
nodes.summary: Downloads one training video, runs ffmpeg-extracted visual features, and writes the results back to the row.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Selects pending training rows, processes each via processVideo, and reports progress and failures.

nodes.name: populate-holdout-benchmarks.py

nodes.name: load_env
nodes.summary: Reads .env-style files and exports the values into the process environment.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Pulls holdout videos, computes benchmark metrics, and writes them to the benchmarks table.

nodes.name: populate-training-data.ts

nodes.name: parseArgs
nodes.summary: Parses CLI arguments controlling niche scope, batch size, and dry-run mode.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Loads labeled videos, runs feature extraction over each, and upserts the resulting training rows.

nodes.languageNotes: Pure inference engine; called from the Node pipeline via subprocess. Exposes load_model, predict, and get_prediction_interval as module-level functions.

nodes.name: load_model
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted XGBoost booster from disk for inference.

nodes.name: load_feature_names
nodes.summary: Loads the ordered list of feature names the model expects.

nodes.name: load_feature_importance
nodes.summary: Loads per-feature importance scores for downstream explainability.

nodes.name: get_prediction_interval
nodes.summary: Derives a prediction interval from the point prediction, confidence score, and held-out metrics.

nodes.name: predict
nodes.summary: Runs the XGBoost model over a feature vector and returns prediction, confidence, and interval.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: reads a JSON feature vector from stdin and emits the model's prediction as JSON.

nodes.name: preflight_check.ts

nodes.name: processVideo
nodes.summary: Scores a single scraped video against its cohort and persists the DPS row.

nodes.name: printProgress
nodes.summary: Prints incremental progress while the DPS pipeline iterates over videos.

nodes.name: printSummary

nodes.name: prove-prompt41.ts

nodes.name: recalc-dps-cohort.ts
nodes.summary: Recalculates cohort-based DPS scores for all videos in a niche using the dps-v2 trainer module.

nodes.summary: Loads all videos belonging to a niche cohort from Supabase for downstream DPS recalculation.

nodes.name: recalculate-dps-direct.js
nodes.summary: Direct (non-batched) DPS recalculation script for ad-hoc fixes when the cohort pipeline is not appropriate.

nodes.name: recalculateDPS
nodes.summary: Iterates every target video and rewrites its DPS score using the legacy direct formula.

nodes.name: recalculate-dps-proper.ts
nodes.summary: Proper cohort-aware DPS recalculation that computes cohort statistics first and applies them per video.

nodes.name: calculateCohortStats
nodes.summary: Computes cohort statistics (mean, sd, percentiles) over a follower-bucketed video set.

nodes.name: calculateProperDPS
nodes.summary: Combines cohort statistics with raw video metrics to produce the canonical DPS score.

nodes.name: rescore-legacy-to-v2.ts
nodes.summary: Large data-migration script that rescores legacy prediction runs to the v2 methodology by reconciling multiple outcome sources, follower counts, and cohort lookups.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements multiple fallback resolvers (tryOutcomeSnapshots, tryMetricCheckSchedule, tryRunActualColumns, tryBulkDownloadItems, tryScrapedData) to gather ground-truth metrics from heterogeneous historical sources.

nodes.name: tryOutcomeSnapshots
nodes.summary: Attempts to fetch ground-truth outcome metrics from the outcome_snapshots table for a run.

nodes.name: tryMetricCheckSchedule
nodes.summary: Fallback resolver that reads metrics from the metric_check_schedule history.

nodes.name: tryRunActualColumns
nodes.summary: Pulls the legacy actual_* columns directly from the prediction_runs row.

nodes.name: tryBulkDownloadItems
nodes.summary: Inspects bulk_download_items rows as another fallback source for outcome metrics.

nodes.name: tryScrapedData
nodes.summary: Falls back to the most recent scraped_videos record for the same video id.

nodes.name: resolveMetrics
nodes.summary: Walks the ordered fallback resolvers until it has a usable metric set for the row.

nodes.name: enrichFollowerCount
nodes.summary: Looks up the creator's follower count at prediction time so cohort assignment is correct.

nodes.name: getCohort
nodes.summary: Returns the cohort statistics for a niche, caching results across calls.

nodes.name: resolveNiche
nodes.summary: Resolves the niche associated with a given video id for cohort lookup.

nodes.name: assignTrustAndWeight
nodes.summary: Assigns a trust label and weighting factor based on which data source produced the metrics and how many signals were available.

nodes.name: rescoreSingleRow
nodes.summary: Rescores one prediction run end-to-end: resolves metrics, enriches followers, picks cohort, recomputes DPS, and stages the update.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Loads candidate legacy runs, iterates rescoreSingleRow with concurrency limits, batches updates, and prints a summary.

nodes.name: rescore-to-v2-1.ts

nodes.name: resolveNiche
nodes.summary: Resolves the niche associated with a video id for the v2.1 rescore.

nodes.name: getCohortRows
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches the cohort row set for a niche and follower bucket, with retry on transient errors.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Drives the v2.1 rescore loop: selects candidate runs, recomputes scores against current cohorts, and stages writes.

nodes.name: writeBatch
nodes.summary: Persists a batched set of rescored run updates back to Supabase with error handling.

nodes.name: printSummary
nodes.summary: Prints the final summary of the v2.1 rescore including totals, changes, and failure breakdown.
